repos_data.description: Local MCP server that extracts high-level Git repository context for AI coding agents

The open-source MCP server behind ByteAsk Embedded Docs: a source-grounded, page-cited evidence-retrieval server for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) that write firmware / driver / protocol code and need exact facts.

Codebase Context gives AI agents understanding of your codebase through semantic code search, team conventions, patterns, and memory, so they use fewer tokens, spend less time, and produce better, more familiar output.
Structural memory for coding agents — index your repo once, query symbols, callers, and call-edges over MCP.
Persistent memory and cross-session learning for AI coding assistants. Cloud-based context management via MCP.
MCP Server for persistent code indexing. Gives AI assistants (Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor) instant access to your codebase. 50x less context than grep.
Local-first MCP server that gives coding agents structured context packets, code/schema facts, and diagnostics - backed by a local SQLite store.
Give Claude Code instant access to your project's institutional knowledge. Drop docs in .context/, mention them with @, and watch Claude become an expert on your codebase.
17 MCP query tools for codebase navigation — functions, classes, imports, dependency graphs, change impact. Zero dependencies. 87% token reduction.

Model Context Protocol server for code intelligence. Lets AI assistants explore your codebase on demand — semantic context with dependency graphs, compressed symbol indexes for TypeScript/JavaScript, plus git diffs and ripgrep-powered search across any language.
MCP for semantic code search & navigation that reduces token waste

repo_meta_data.description: C/C++ semantic index for AI coding assistants — powered by your compile_commands.json. Query the program your compiler actually builds, not just the source files.
